# BPMN Desk 0.7.0

- **Restore your workspace.** Resume diagram and monitor tabs with their order, active tab, diagram contents, unapplied XML, selection and view. Keep up to 15 recent sessions, or pin and name working sets outside that limit.
- **Work in several windows.** Use File → New window (`Ctrl+Shift+N`) or launch the app again without a file. Restoring a session from an occupied window opens another window; an already open session brings its window forward. Launching with a file uses the active window.
- **Handle changes on disk.** Tab indicators and tooltips distinguish local edits, external changes and conflicts. Reload from disk, save a separate copy, confirm an overwrite or recreate a deleted file without silently replacing your diagram.
- **Manage tabs and recent work.** Tab menus include duplication, reload, showing a file in its folder and bulk closing. Overflowing tabs have scroll buttons and fading edges; the new-tab button stays visible. The start page keeps sessions and recent files together with compact diagram and monitor launchers.
- **Find exported files.** SVG and PNG exports show a completion notice with a Show in folder action. The native menu includes both white and transparent PNG backgrounds, with consistent dialog labels.

Restoration preserves document snapshots, not Undo/Redo stacks or navigation history. Monitor data is fetched again; connection secrets are not stored in session snapshots. Pinned sessions update as you work after restoring them. A taskbar click may focus an existing window instead of launching the app, depending on the desktop.

Linux AppImage, Windows installer/portable and `SHA256SUMS` are built and checked by GitHub Actions. Windows executables are unsigned; macOS is not available.
